name: kaal-engineering
description: Engineering repository for KAAL. The distributable packages are under packages/.

scripts.test: npm run test:hosting && npm run test:kaal && npm run test:engineering
scripts.test:kaal: npm run test:workspaces && npm run test:acceptance
scripts.test:workspaces: npm run build -w kaal-hosting && node engineering/lanes/workspaces.mjs
scripts.test:acceptance: npm run build -w kaal-hosting && node --test engineering/acceptance/embed.test.mjs engineering/acceptance/engineer-skill.test.mjs
